submitted.rationale: All measured EQEs are at the noise floor (~0.002%) at 2.1 eV illumination. This is expected because the Pb antimonate phases (Pb2Sb2O7, PbSb2O6) have wide band gaps. Index 0 (Sb 0.24), the most Pb-rich composition, had the highest value at 0.00288%. That fits the idea that PbO-rich material absorbs a little sub-2.1 eV light, but the margin over the others is within noise.
